layout.arrangement: Title slide: large light-gray panel filling most of the slide with a thin red border; inside it a smaller white rectangle with a thin red border centered vertically, containing three centered lines of title text; a small yellow circle with the slide number '39' sits at the top-right corner of the gray panel

regions.name: outer gray panel
regions.position: fills slide from ~5% to ~95% width, ~8% to ~100% height
regions.content: light gray background panel with thin red outline

regions.name: inner white title box
regions.content: white rectangle with thin red border containing the three-line title

regions.name: title text
regions.content: Line 1: 'Nearest Neighbor (NN)' in blue; Line 2: 'and' in black; Line 3: 'K -Nearest Neighbor (K -NN)' in red

regions.name: slide number badge
regions.position: top-right corner of gray panel, ~90-93% width, ~10-17% height
regions.content: yellow circle with dark outline containing '39'

layout.hierarchy: The three-line centered title dominates; line 1 (blue) and line 3 (red) are largest and boldest, line 2 'and' is smaller black text; the yellow slide-number circle is a minor accent

visual_elements.description: Outer light-gray rectangle with thin red/maroon border framing the whole slide content
Inner white rectangle with thin red/maroon border containing the title text
Small yellow circle with dark outline containing the number '39' (slide number badge)

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout; title lines 1 and 3 are large and bold (blue and red respectively), the word 'and' is smaller black regular/bold text; slide number is small dark text inside the yellow circle
animation_state: Fully built static title slide; no partial reveals
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background white. 2. Draw a large rectangle covering ~90% of the slide (margins ~5% left/right, ~8% top), fill light gray (#E8E8E8), outline thin red (#B03030). 3. Inside it, draw a centered white rectangle (~85% width, ~55% height) with thin red outline (#B03030). 4. Add a centered text box inside the white rectangle with three lines: 'Nearest Neighbor (NN)' in bold blue (#0000CC), 'and' in smaller black, 'K -Nearest Neighbor (K -NN)' in bold red (#CC0000) — note the space after 'K' in 'K -Nearest' and 'K -NN'. 5. Add a small yellow circle (#F5E97A) with dark outline at the top-right corner of the gray panel, containing the text '39' in small dark font.
